find:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
replace:
name: Import & route smoke tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
notes: Job-level 1-minute limit on smoke. In inj-001.log setup-python takes ~50 s (20:07:36 -> 20:08:26) and 'pip install -r requirements.txt' ~2 min (20:08:26 -> 20:10:25), so the job is killed about 10 s into 'Install dependencies' (or in setup-python on a slow runner). Later steps never run, so there is no pytest summary; docker (needs: smoke) is skipped. Code is unchanged; the fix is the timeout-minutes line in ci.yml. The exact GitHub kill message is not yet observed; check it in the saved log.
